subject: Banking
title: Digital Currencies from Central Banks
description: A micro-lesson that makes Digital Currencies from Central Banks usable.

hook.text: Over 130 countries are developing central bank digital currencies.

buildup.text: CBDCs would let citizens hold accounts directly at the central bank. No commercial bank needed as an intermediary.

discovery.text: Instant, free payments between anyone with a CBDC wallet. No Visa, no Swift, no clearing delays.

twist.text: CBDCs give governments total visibility into spending. Every transaction recorded.

climax.text: CBDCs offer efficiency at the cost of privacy. The future of money depends on how that tradeoff is resolved.

punchline.text: 130 countries exploring digital money. Efficiency vs. privacy is the battle.

quiz.question: What is a major concern about CBDCs?
options: Governments could track every transaction, eliminating financial privacy
